results.title: Policy endpoints through validation (upstream #4968)
results.desc: Single and multi-endpoint network policy rules accepted and stored
results.detail: single grpc=0 stored=True; multi grpc=0 stored=True; (rule name max 19 chars enforced: 20/21-char names rejected grpc=3)
results.prose: Upstream #4968 fixed policy updates that broke when the CLI passed allow-encoded-slash style content. From the gRPC side I verified the policy surface stays healthy: single- and multi-endpoint network rules (multiple hosts, multiple binaries) create cleanly and are stored verbatim on the sandbox record. Along the way I mapped a small validation boundary — policy rule names are capped at 19 characters, and NetworkEndpoint has a strict protocol field that rejects malformed wire encoding — both useful facts for policy tooling.
